title: Defence Research Framework Launched in India
summary: Rajnath Singh has launched a new Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) framework aimed at speeding up defence research and development projects. The move is expected to enhance efficiency and timely execution of R&D projects. The government has not specified the details of the revised framework, but it is expected to facilitate faster production and induction of systems, platforms, and technologies developed by the DRDO into the armed forces.
summary_points: Rajnath Singh launches new DRDO framework
Framework aims to speed up defence research and development projects
Expected to enhance efficiency and timely execution of R&D projects
Revised framework will facilitate faster production and induction of systems, platforms, and technologies developed by the DRDO

framing.left: The Pioneer highlights the significance of the new framework in speeding up defence research and development projects, while also emphasizing the government's commitment to enhancing national security. framing.center: The Indian Express focuses on the launch of the new framework and its expected benefits, without taking a specific stance on the government's intentions or the implications for national security.
